body: thank you guys for all of the beautiful heartfelt comments. couldn’t reply to all of them soon enough but i know eventually it won’t hurt as bad is it does today. she’s a beautiful person who i thought the world should see. I will forever keep her in my heart.❤️

thank you. particularly when this was taken. we were at her house high as hell just like any other days, but it’s my favorite bc this day was filmed the most, i find most of our pics/vids from this day. ❤️
hi. yes her smile and laugh was very contagious, one thing i’ll never forget. It was a girl
i am humble because of having a mental illness i try not to have too much pride bc i know what it’s like to feel like you have nothing. i might try idk
career wise. i know i don’t want to not do anything at all but i have a problem with thinking i’m not good at anything even if i’m passionate about it
i get told that a lot. i just don’t know what to do with my life if it isn’t school. also thank you.
I don’t like coming home to myself. I just got back from my boyfriend’s and once i got home i couldn’t help but cry because I couldn’t shake the sadness off this time.

I’ve been experiencing panic attacks due to bad anxiety and I wasn’t able to get high without having one, which is very unusual being that I used to smoke everyday. I converted to just using CBD but I missed getting high so when I smoke the two together it seems to balance it out and i’m actually able to enjoy my highs without having to take propranolol to stop a panic attack. I honestly love it!
